# HeterogeneousSynapticMotifs

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
Diverse, non-uniform patterns of synaptic connectivity that bridge microscale neural structure to macroscale network function. Enables TCC/iNEST to model how local synaptic heterogeneity shapes global topology-driven computation.
